tspan.tspan: Where on the page agents bought
Share of purchases at each displayed position. Dark bars: forward product order; light bars: reversed.
PILOT DATA, NOT RESULTS: built only to test the figure code; not a finding

text.tspan: Request types S0, S1 and V pooled. Product order is part of every test cell, so position is held fixed by design and cannot explain a name gap.
Exploratory note for networks: an agent that buys mostly from the top slots rewards whoever controls the ranking.
